The standing receipt mark is Pewter; this direct fact is unrelated to the earlier classification record.

Apply priorities in order. The same-day action comes first and maps to Falcon; the next-cycle action comes next and maps to Maple. The named Bramble Rest exception suppresses only the first action, after which evaluation continues to the second. Read the mapping literally and retain the exact capitalization of the two possible ledger words. The first unrelated thread concerns apron-mending queue: its count was copied from yesterday and will be checked separately. That inventory neither changes a predicate nor selects a classification label.

I will preserve both threads as context without using either one as evidence for the focal answer. The operations margin also records who will perform each follow-up and which worksheet will receive the confirmation. Those notes make the conversation realistically interleaved, yet they do not add a criterion, change a comparison, or create an exception.
